description: When no witness lies below a specified bound, bounded search returns the bound itself.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.bounded_failure {k : ℕ}
  (P : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args (k + 1) → Prop)
  (x : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args k) (b : ℕ)
  (hn : ∀ i < b, ¬P (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x i)) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.boundedPredicateSearch P x b = b
